patterns.pattern: ^As your blow lands with a crunch, you perceive that you have dealt (?<amount>[\d.]+)% damage to (?<name>\w+)'s (?<limb>.+)\.$
^As you carve into (?<name>\w+), you perceive that you have dealt (?<amount>[\d.]+)% damage to \w+ (?<limb>.+)\.$
^Bracing your feet, you launch a devastating slash at the (\w+) of (\w+), delivering a glancing blow\.$
^Winding up a devastating stroke of your warhammer, you unleash a crushing blow aimed at the (\w+) of (\w+)\.$
^You whip .+? in a vicious arc, hewing savagely into the (\w+) of (\w+)\.$
^You direct a devastating two-handed blow with .+? at the already injured (\w+) of (\w+)\.$
^With a single, terrible blow, you bring .+? whirling about to cleave into the already injured (\w+) of (\w+)\.$
^Bringing .+? around in a savage arc, you viciously pulverise the already injured (\w+) of (\w+)\.$
^Adjusting your footing, you unleash a horrific slash at the (\w+) of (\w+), cleaving flesh and shattering bone in a savage display of your suprem[ae]cy\.$
^Drawing back .+?, you deliver a single, crippling blow to the (\w+) of (\w+), mangling bone and meat in a bloody spray\.$
^(\w+) takes some salve from a vial and rubs it on \w+ (.+?)\.$
